gloss: self-important; stuck-up; acting like a big shot

definitions.gloss: self-important; stuck-up; acting like a big shot
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who behaves as if they were more important or knowledgeable than they are. Always critical — it describes the impression the person gives, not their actual standing.

examples.japanese: {偉|えら}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has a self-important look on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{偉|えら}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: He's new here, yet he gives orders like he's in charge.

examples.japanese: {偉|えら}そうなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦できていない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I said something high-handed, but then realized I can't do it myself yet either.

notes:
⟦{偉|えら}い→偉い：00039_erai⟧ (great, admirable) plus the suffix そう (seeming). Because そう describes appearance rather than fact, {偉|えら}そう means "acting great" — and in practice always implies the person is not.

USAGE:
Behaves as a na-adjective: {偉|えら}そうな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a self-important attitude), {偉|えら}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to talk like a big shot). The adverbial {偉|えら}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is the most common form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偉|えら}そうな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an arrogant manner
- {偉|えら}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say something in a high-handed way
- {偉|えら}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な: don't act so important

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生意気|なまいき}→生意気：08271_namaiki⟧: cheeky, impudent — stronger, and typically aimed at someone younger or junior
- ⟦{威張|いば}る→威張る：12224_ibaru⟧: to throw one's weight around — a verb describing the behavior itself
